messages:
anya: quick status check — pushing quantization recs for r2 models this week. need an owner for the rollout plan and callout on which routes should keep fp16 fallback. @mike you mentioned a canary lane?

mike: can take the canary lane. planning to run 10% traffic for 48h then evaluate perf/cost. who has the prompt set for quality regression? :thinking_face:

devon: i can assemble the prompt set. will include the top 5 customer flows + a small adversarial set. pinging @sophie for expected latency SLO inheritance for canary routes.

sophie: latency SLOs: host tier routes keep 150ms p99, internal debug routes can be 300ms. canary should aim for <180ms p95 during test.

anya: perfect. devon can you drop the prompt set link here by EOD? we also need batching/cache config for canary — prefer conservative batching (max_batch=8, max_wait_ms=12) and KV cache enabled for 1h TTL.

devon: will drop link later. quick Q: does the runtime require any kernel flags for int8 paths? i saw a warning in the shim.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-gpu-pool -> start 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z. check logs at https://infra.redwood/deploys/2543216789.

mike: kernel flag = `--use-quant-kernel` yes, but note it's gated behind the model profile feature flag. i pushed a small infra PR to enable for canary. @jordan can you review the PR?

jordan: on it, will review in 30m. if all good i can merge and trigger canary.

devon: prompt set uploaded: https://internal.redwood/prompt-sets/optkit-canary-v1 — includes regression checks and expected outputs. test harness script is `tools/eval/run_canary.sh` (run with `--record`).

anya: thanks. last thing — ownership: mike owns rollout execution, devon owns prompt/quality, jordan owns infra/merge, sophie owns SLO signoff. i'll own the cross-team comms. if any blocker pops up tag #incidents and ping me. :thumbsup:

mike: noted. i'll kick off the canary after jordan merges.

jordan: merged, starting canary now. logs: https://infra.redwood/canary/2543216789/logs — ping if anything spikes.

devon: running evals now. first pass looks fine, one regression on summarization prompt (length truncation). filing a small prompt tweak PR.

anya: filing that as a rollback candidate if perf degrades; keep us posted. thanks team.
